view.scene_description: A modern, brightly lit interior space features a central spiral bookshelf illuminated by LED lights. Large windows reveal an urban exterior. A red spiral staircase curves on the left. People are seated at tables or walking through the area. The floor is polished, reflecting overhead lights and surrounding structures.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: Tall, cylindrical structure with multiple circular shelves, each holding books. Illuminated by white LED strips along its edges. Positioned centrally in the room, surrounded by seating. Appears freestanding but likely anchored to the floor.

objects.label: red spiral staircase
objects.observation: Curved staircase with a bold red railing and steps. Located on the left side of the frame, partially visible. Its base rests on the polished floor. No visible supports or connections beyond the floor contact.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Extensive glass panes covering the right and rear walls, offering views of buildings outside. Bright daylight streams through them. Some window frames are visible. They appear to be fixed installations.

objects.label: seating area
objects.observation: Circular table with several metal stools around it, positioned near the bookshelf. People are seated or standing nearby. Stools have black seats and chrome legs. Table surface is light-colored wood or laminate.

objects.label: person walking
objects.observation: Man in dark clothing walking from right to left near the center. He is partially obscured by the bookshelf. His posture suggests movement. No visible interaction with other objects.

objects.label: person sitting
objects.observation: Person seated at a table on the right, facing away from the camera. Wearing light-colored shirt. Their hands are on the table. Partially obscured by another person and window glare.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: Large green leafy plant in a beige pot, located on the far right near the windows. It stands on the polished floor. Leaves are broad and lush, adding natural contrast to the modern interior.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000045", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
